name: qlrisk_price_swaption
title: Price a Swaption
description:
Price one Swaption - option to enter into a swap (qlrisk Swaption): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): notional (amount; default 1000000), expiry* (tenor like 3Y or date), swap_start* (tenor like 3Y or date), swap_end* (tenor like 3Y or date), strike_pct* (percent, 3 = 3%), swaption_type (payer/receiver; default payer), exercise_style (european/american/bermudan; default european), floating_index (see the schema's list; default SOFR), volatility_pct (percent, 3 = 3%), currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, counterparty_id, position, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"notional": 1000000, "expiry": "1Y", "swap_start": "1Y", "swap_end": "6Y", "strike_pct": 4} gives NPV 20,450.09 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
